★Request
Display Still in Love (Summer Tracksuit), snapping eyes open
Do you love me?

Please, do not ask for the reason. ...Not yet.
............May I ask this of you?

(Nowhere. There is nowhere I belong... because we are... broken.
How terrifying... there could never be anyone who would love me...—)

Yet a crimson haze veiled those doubts. From the moment I wandered into
that bewitching world on that summer night—I knew there was no way back.

Yes...! Still is...
Right here...—

Huh...? 
...Kyaaah?!

A few days later, on the night of a full moon... Still in Love called me out.
—To the place where I first met her. Come to think of it, it was a full moon that day as well.

Yes...
...Um, I have a favor to ask.

................Um.
Even after things turned out like this...

If it wouldn't be... an imposition on you, Trainer.
—Would you walk "together" with me... from here on out?

Yes.
...This is... the first time...
Ahahaha HAHAHA hahaha hahahahaha HA ha haaahhh!!

"She" inside Still in Love was already beginning to stir awake.
Feeling my heartbeat race... I gave instructions, struggling to keep my voice from trembling.

(...Ngh, ah... my heart is stirring... she's waking up!
Even though they are watching me...! Ah, but... but...—)

Tonight is a full moon. The primal blood within me... knew no sleep.
The moonlight exposes that blood... Perhaps that is why.

Unbound by reason, her instinct raged in sheer ecstasy... For a moment, I was
spellbound by the sight. But remembering what she had asked of me... I cried out.

When that girl comes out...
Could you please let me hear your voice?
Because you are—my fated one.

Looking down so anxiously, she seemed so frail and helpless...
I wanted to reach out to her right away... but my fingertips hesitated.

Could it be because... I forced it? The exhaustion was overwhelming...
I lost consciousness halfway through... and she took over again.

Ugh... *hic*... No... That's not it...
That isn't... "me"...

Terrifying... scary... completely insane...
Creepy... bizarre... abnormal...――a monster.

............
I may be clumsy and inexperienced, but... please take good care of me.

Yes.
Please... sign... a trainer contract with me...

(...I have to go! To where they are...!
Because, because... you are... my...――)

No, it has to be you... ...Please.
Please... please, let me stay by your side...

I feel like... with you, I might truly be all right.
I'll do everything I can so I won't be a burden...!

My instincts are throbbing...
...Ngh, it's unbearable.

She's like an entirely different person...
...How creepy...

...――
Thank... you.

...Ngh... ...Y-Yes...
I've... completely returned to myself from her, haven't I?

(...Only them. Only that person... acknowledged me.
They accepted... "me"...)

Love me? DO YOU LOVE ME do you LOVE me? Love me love you do you love me
Love you love me? Love you love you love you love you? Love me

...Ah!
Trainer...!

Ugh... No way, I don't wanna run with Still-chan!
I mean, she's so weird...

The end of this story is already decided. If so, why trace its steps?
...Words untie, melting into the subconscious. Before sinking once more, what appeared was――

(Even someone like me... could be loved?
Is it okay to love? Is it okay... to believe...?)

Fufufu... Ahahaha! Haa... Ahh, this is so good...!
Moonlight, pour down even more...――lay "me" bare!
――Still in Love.

My shoulders are grabbed with incredible force. As that thing with a grinning sneer
opens its mouth wide――she collapses as if crumbling to the ground.

(――...I can hear it...
I must go... I must return... But...――where to?)

I rush over to where she has stopped. At last, reason
has triumphed over instinct... and she managed to regain her senses through sheer will.

That night was especially stifling. The sultry heat clinging to my skin
made it hard to breathe. Added to that was the intolerable itching from the mark on my neck――and a heavy headache.
“Your instincts are――frighteningly beautiful.”

I-I'm so sorry...!
To think that I... in your lap, Trainer...!

Illuminated by the moonlight, Still in Love dashes forward. Her graceful,
fundamentally sound form begins to distort――with gradual acceleration.
“Your instincts are――frighteningly beautiful.”
